report.explanation: Multiple high-confidence, repeated attack alerts, primarily DDoS attacks (LOIC-UDP, HOIC, LOIC-HTTP), indicate a sustained and severe intrusion. Immediate blocking is required to mitigate the ongoing threat.
recommended_actions: Review network logs for further compromise
Implement enhanced rate limiting and traffic filtering
